newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-GOVERNMENT TO DECIDE ON ENERGY REORGANISATION.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-GOVERNMENT TO DECIDE ON ENERGY REORGANISATION.

text.p: The government said on Monday that it will discuss the reorganisation of state-run Lithuanian Energy at a cabinet meeting on Wednesday.

"It is planned to authorise the economy ministry to vote for a reorganisation of the company during the general shareholders' meeting by splitting the company and passing the heating sector to the municipalities," the government's press office said.
The move is part of the government's attempt to decentralise the country's energy sector.
Lithuanian Energy said earlier that the heating energy sector led to 49.1 million litas of losses while electric energy production gave 47.1 million litas of profit in the first quarter.
